🛴 KUKIRIN LIFE POLAND 🇵🇱
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Welcome to Kukirin Life! Hop on your scooter and cruise through Warsaw!

╭──── ⚡ GAME FEATURES ⚡ ────╮
🛴 Ride electric scooters
🏙️ Warsaw Map – Palace of Culture and the city center
🔥 Wheelies with a counter and high scores
💨 Burnouts and DUAL mode
📦 Work as an UberDash delivery driver
⭐ Levels, XP, and daily rewards
🏍️ Huge selection of scooters in the garage
🔧 Tuning Workshop
- Inverted swingarm
- Wheelie bar
- Paint finishes: Matte, Metallic, Chrome, Wrap, Neon
- Screens

🛠️ DEVELOPMENT & UPDATES

We're constantly improving Kukirin Life! New scooters, locations, and features are already on the way, so stay tuned!

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

⭐ ENJOYING THE GAME?

👍 Leave a LIKE to support us!
⭐ Add the game to your FAVORITES so you can easily come back!
👥 Join the Kukirin Life Poland Community GROUP!
